# Logo

The PLUS logo: the mark, or the lockup of mark and wordmark. Seven sizes, six appearances. At 24 and below the mark uses its small-size drawing, and below 24 the lockup gives way to the mark alone.

**Import:** `import { Logo } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/assets/Logo/Logo.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/assets/Logo/Logo.stories.jsx` — Playground, Sizes, SizesDark, SmallSizeDrawing, Lockup, LockupDark, Appearances, LightAndDark, Construction, ClearSpace

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `appearance` | enum | `'colored'` | One of six appearances |
| `size` | enum | `32` | Height of the mark in pixels |
| `wordmark` | bool | `false` | Show the lockup. From size 24; below that the mark stands alone |
| `className` | string | `''` | Additional CSS classes |
